create.heading: Create a team
create.customHint: Up to 20 characters. Keep it friendly: it goes on the leaderboard.
create.nicknameHint: Only your team sees it. It never leaves your team's phones.

join.heading: Join a team
join.codeHint: 4 characters, shown on the host's phone
join.nicknameHint: Only your team sees it. It never leaves your team's phones.

errors.badCode: Codes are 4 letters and numbers, like K7QM.
errors.notFound: Can't find that team. Check the code with your host.
errors.full: That team is full. Teams have up to 4 players.
errors.noNetwork: Can't reach the game server. Check the internet and try again.
errors.nameDigits: Letters only, please: no numbers in the team name.
errors.nickDigits: Letters only, please: no numbers in your nickname.

lobby.scanHint: Teammates scan this, or tap Join a team and type the code.
lobby.rotationNote: Players take turns: one plays each stage while the rest watch and help. Player 1 plays the finale.
lobby.needTwo: You need at least 2 players to start.
lobby.stillConnecting: {names} still connecting. Tap Start again to go without them.

pill.sending: Score saved. Sending when you're back online.

ended.lobbyExpired: The lobby closed after 15 minutes without a start.
ended.runExpired: This team run has ended (60-minute limit).

debrief.submitting: Adding your team to today's board…
debrief.notRanked: This run couldn't go on the board.
debrief.retrying: No connection yet. We'll keep trying.
debrief.notRankedQuick: Too quick for the board: the run was under the minimum time.
debrief.notRankedName: That team name can't go on the board.

waiting.tip: Watch {name}'s screen and talk it through together!
waiting.turnsDone: Your turns are done. Cheer your team on!
